sourceContract: Codex CLI hook JSON protocol (Stop) for a second turn of the same session, carrying the advanced session-wide cumulative total_token_usage
author: otel-hook integration owner (agent)
sanitization: Token counts are round invented figures chosen to advance monotonically over stop.json, not a measurement of any real turn; model id is the publicly documented name only.
notes: Second point on the session's cumulative curve (13500 -> 22500). Exists so a multi-turn replay proves the derived delta is the 9000-token difference rather than the whole 22500 snapshot re-counted under a new turn_id.
